note_tsim: Added illustrated title page, with title Atlas Coelestis , engraved by J.C. Reinsperger, plates by J.B. Homann, and after his death, by J.G. Ebersberger.

This atlas may have been given to Italian dictator Benito Mussolini's brother, Arnaldo Mussolini, journalist and politician and founder of several Fascist related newspapers. Inscription at beginning of volume reads: "Al valoroso Arnaldo Mussolini fundatore Rivista Historia / Omaggio / 18[?] Luglio 1927" Dated July 1927.
